orientation.label_semantics: Corrective counterclockwise degrees; direct argmax of raw network output; no softmax added, threshold or oracle fallback.
orientation.preprocess: RGB; aspect preserve short-edge256 round both dims; OpenCV INTER_LINEAR; center224 crop using integer floor; per-channel float32 pixel*=((1/255)/std), pixel+=(-mean/std), ImageNet RGB mean [.485,.456,.406], std [.229,.224,.225], matching tagged PaddleX arithmetic; NCHW batch1.
orientation.official_inference_yml:
Global:
  model_name: PP-LCNet_x1_0_doc_ori
Hpi:
  backend_configs:
    paddle_infer:
      trt_dynamic_shapes: &id001
        x:
        - - 1
          - 3
          - 224
          - 224
        - - 1
          - 3
          - 224
          - 224
        - - 8
          - 3
          - 224
          - 224
    tensorrt:
      dynamic_shapes: *id001
PreProcess:
  transform_ops:
  - ResizeImage:
      resize_short: 256
  - CropImage:
      size: 224
  - NormalizeImage:
      channel_num: 3
      mean:
      - 0.485
      - 0.456
      - 0.406
      order: ''
      scale: 0.00392156862745098
      std:
      - 0.229
      - 0.224
      - 0.225
  - ToCHWImage: null
PostProcess:
  Topk:
    topk: 1
    label_list:
    - '0'
    - '90'
    - '180'
    - '270'
orientation.correction: numpy.rot90(full RGB raster, predicted_label//90), exact right-angle permutation; no interpolation.

ocr.recognizer_language: CH explicitly fixed for English plus Chinese; no language detection or per-page switching.
ocr.scope: Full normalized page; preserve library output order and all raw stage results before score filtering. No selected-region crop or reading-order repair.

coordinate_convention: Top-left origin, x right, y down, continuous raster edges [0,W]x[0,H]; sample centers column+.5,row+.5. Save 3x3 source-raster->normalized and inverse. Normalize detector quadrilaterals back through inverse then divide by render scale3 to original physical PDF points. Physical page never renumbered.
